rules.title: Majuli ferry: motorcycles go aboard
rules.detail: A May 2026 article and an August 2026 guide both describe motorcycles being carried on the government ferries from Nimati Ghat. No official statement or fare table was found.

gaps: No official statement found that the Majuli ferry carries motorcycles, nor an official fare for them; the ferry portal's landing page does not say.
Whether motorcycles go on every vessel or only on the larger vehicle-carrying vessels was not established.
The district website gives ferry hours but not a sailing-by-sailing timetable, and does not say whether vehicles are carried.
No flood-season speed order for 2025 or 2026 was found; the latest seen is July 2024.
Status of the bridge being built between Jorhat and Majuli not sourced.
Highest point and usual number of days not sourced; the route is in the plains.
No source found stating that Assam needs no permit for Indian or foreign citizens.
Kaziranga park opening and closing dates were not collected; they govern safaris, not the highway.
